Small multiples are the strongest answer to overplotting: one panel per group, shared axes, and the eye does the comparison.
[`facet-wrap`](../reference/facets/facet-wrap.qmd) and [`facet-grid`](../reference/facets/facet-grid.qmd) handle the splitting, with free scales when panels span very different ranges; keep scales shared whenever the comparison is the point.
Coordinate systems clip, fix, flip, or transform the panel itself, and [`compose`](../reference/core/compose.qmd) arranges several plots with shared legends.
Every example ships its full source: click **View source** to copy it.
